Drag band · transfeminist · queer
Electronic hip-hop with live wind instruments, video, smoke and loads of sass
home.home_intro: We are Las Marikarmen, pure queer punk energy mixing electronics with the power of two saxophones and a clarinet played live. We channel activism from the Basque Country, Leganés and a Nordic nomad life, and mix it in Collserola with performance and a sonic explosion that defies every genre label. This isn't just music: it's a statement, a show, a journey.

about.bio_p1: Las Marikarmen is a drag band fed by transfeminism and queerness. We mix music, performance and lived experience: hip-hop and trap with electronic pop, two saxophones and a clarinet played live, drag, video projections and fog programmed to the beat.
about.bio_p2: We were born in 2017 to make room for dissident identities in rural Collserola (Barcelona). We organise horizontally, without hierarchies, and take that idea on stage: we all sing, play, perform, make video, dance… and whatever else it takes!
about.bio_p3: In the house of Marikarmen we have our mother, Lady Marikarmen, a great pioneer of the transfeminist world. Since her death we honour her legacy and carry on her fight: embracing old queer ways of life that were wiped out, and destroying heteropatriarchy, cisnormativity and compulsory binarism.
about.bio_banner: Destroy the heteropatriarchy, cis-normativity and the compulsory gender binary!
about.members_many: The band's success rests on many different people taking part since 2017. These are the current ones.

about.motto_vic: my egg keeps falling out of my skirt
about.motto_conta: I live in a parallel world
about.bio_vic: Multidisciplinary street choni. Struts when walking. Trapped in an endless loop of hunting for jewellery. Their genitals can't stay inside a skirt. Also an acrobat, super charismatic and dripping with autotune.
about.bio_hipo: A mythological Basque creature who never knows where she is because she has no sense of direction. Her shockwaves grind machos into the ground, and they lose their memory when the clarinet plays.
about.bio_conta: A non-binary creature from intergalactic space, found living under a tree in Japan. Loves origami and coconut. Their eyebrows are both wings and interplanetary radio transmitters. They play the sax to train their lungs and survive in this atmosphere.

show.show_deck: Lady Marikarmen's folkloric funeral becomes a multimedia party of electronic hip-hop, horns and drag.
show.show_p1: Video projections, lights and a column of fog with LEDs programmed to the beat. We play on stage and come down into the audience. An explosive live show full of surprises that everyone is invited to: a journey of rediscovery and madness through the queer universe of Las Marikarmen.
show.show_p2: Every concert is a ritual full of symbolism and critical humour against heteropatriarchy and cisnormativity. We all leave with more solidarity and more allies.
show.funeral_alt: Las Marikarmen live, with Lady Marikarmen's portrait among flowers
show.quote_contamina: We take cis men, put them in the sun and they cry.

shop.order_privacy: Your data is not stored on this website: the form only runs in your browser and sends nothing to any server. It just drafts an email that you choose to send from your own mail app to lasmarikarmen@anartist.org. We keep that email in our inbox only to handle and ship your order, we don't share it with anyone, and we delete it whenever you ask. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which logs technical visit data (such as IP addresses).

press.quote_kaos: We revel in the hatred society throws at us and turn it into empowerment and self-love.
press.quote_rutalokal: Musically, they carve out a place in the emerging new punk scene (autotune, rage and machine beats), combining Andalusian broken rhythms, Basque music and the sound of the saxophones and clarinet that so define the band.
press.quote_beteve: A performative band set on undermining heteropatriarchy, breaking the narrative of cisnormativity and ending the reductionism of binarism.
press.quote_vic: A queer band bringing in pop and Balkan ideas, beats, costume, make-up and a little bit of ourselves too.
press.quote_enderrock: Its performative, interactive live show becomes a celebration of dissident identities, a space of care and love…

lyrics.lyr_intro: We write to name what happens to us and turn it into a party. Our lyrics come from the street, the squat and the dancefloor, in the unpolished faggy, travesti slang we actually speak. We sing about trans and non-binary bodies that refuse to fit in, about the right to take up public space without fear, about police violence and the neighbourhood machos, about care work nobody pays for, about pleasure, sex work and shameless desire, about cities that push out the people who live in them, and about solidarity with Palestine. We do it with humour, rage and glitter, because laughing at the cistem is self-defence too.
